---
title: "Week 10: Soul of Rust"
---

## Introduction

This week we will follow small Rust programs to see who owns a value, what happens when it moves, and how a function can borrow it to read or change it. We'll predict outputs, read compiler diagnostics, and make one change at a time. The main lesson covers ownership, borrowing, string slices, and keeping borrowed data valid; named lifetime annotations are an optional extension.
